text: माझा फोन चार्ज करता येईल का?
romanization_iso15919: mājhā phōna cārja karatā yēīla kā?
ipa: mˈaːɟʰaː pʰˈoːn cˈaːrz kˈʌɾtˌaː jeːˈiːl kˈaː

text: मला धूम्रपान न करण्याची खोली हवी आहे
romanization_iso15919: malā dhūmrapāna na karaṇyācī khōlī havī āhē
ipa: mˈʌlaː dʰˈuːmɾəpˌaːn nˈə kˌəɾɳjˈaːci kʰˈoːli hˈʌvi ˈaːheː

literal: two separate beds, not one double

text: आणखी एक रात्र राहता येईल का?
romanization_iso15919: āṇakhī ēka rātra rāhatā yēīla kā?
ipa: ˈaːɳkʰˌi ˈeːk ɾˈaːtɾə ɾˈaːhətˌaː jeːˈiːl kˈaː

literal: stop the massage -- naming it removes the reading 'pause'
दाब is pressure proper, not speed or force of character
do it with a light hand
the pressure is right, keep doing just this

text: ठीक आहे, मी तो भाग टाळेन
romanization_iso15919: ṭhīka āhē, mī tō bhāga ṭāḷēna
ipa: ʈʰˈiːk ˈaːheː, mˈi tˈoː bʰˈaːɡ ʈaːɭˈeːn
literal: future -ēn does not mark gender, unlike the present or the past
verbless; the adjectives agree with भाग, not with anyone present

text: या उपचारात हा भाग टाळता येत नाही
romanization_iso15919: yā upacārāta hā bhāga ṭāḷatā yēta nāhī
ipa: jˈaː ˌʊpcaːɾˈaːt hˈaː bʰˈaːɡ ʈˈaːɭtˌaː jˈeːt nˈaːhi
literal: the येणे impersonal, which has no agreement with a speaker
दुखतं is neuter and impersonal, so no आप-plus-participle agreement arises

text: मला खात्री नाही, मला वरिष्ठांना विचारावं लागेल
romanization_iso15919: malā khātrī nāhī, malā variṣṭhāṁnā vicārāvaṁ lāgēla
ipa: mˈʌlaː kʰˈaːtɾi nˈaːhi, mˈʌlaː vˌəɾɪʂʈʰˈãnaː vˌɪcaːɾˈaːvən laːɡˈeːl
literal: dative subject plus the neuter obligative, both ungendered; वरिष्ठ is an invariant adjective-noun, so the supervisor is not gendered either
